title: Lady Meets Karma After Drunk Driving With Child
description:
On August 28th, 2023, an officer conducted a traffic stop on a suspicious vehicle that had its windows covered with a black cloth. Upon approaching the vehicle, the officer observed resistance from the driver. Even after repeated requests, she was unwilling to exit her vehicle. The female was not complying, so the officers took necessary action. The officers had to deploy a taser as they had no other option to control the woman. One of the officers checked on the female's daughter to make sure she was okay. One of the officers found a gun in the female’s car. The female came out of her cell because one of the officers had forgotten to lock it. The female was charged with abuse of a child, aggravated driving under influence, negligent use of a deadly weapon, speeding, concealing identity, resisting arrest and obstructing official business.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
